title: A module is finitely generated if its localizations at a family generating the unit ideal are (Stacks 00EO(2))
statement: Let $R$ be a commutative ring, $M$ an $R$-module, and $f_1,\dots,f_k\in R$ elements generating the unit ideal ($(f_1,\dots,f_k)=R$). For each $i$ let $M_{f_i}$ be the localization of $M$ at $f_i$, an $R_{f_i}$-module [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away]. If every $M_{f_i}$ is a finitely generated $R_{f_i}$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module], then $M$ is a finitely generated $R$-module.
